name: 謝心心
objective:
本課程專為研究所設計，旨在排除製程干擾，深入探討材料科學理論在光電領域中的核心地位。課程將結合光波特性與半導體科學，解析光電材料在原子與電子層級的行為。內容聚焦於 LED、雷射二極體與太陽能電池的材料分類、組織變態與強化機構。課程將特別探討金屬、高分子等奈米複合材料系統 如何影響光電元件的轉換效率。透過分析材料失效原因與防止方法，學生將能從材料本質出發，理解界面穩定性對元件壽命的影響。課程亦包含論文研讀，引導學生追蹤前沿材料研究趨勢。
Specifically designed for graduate students, this course focuses on the fundamental Material Science theories in the optoelectronic and semiconductor field, excluding thin-film manufacturing processes. The curriculum integrates thermodynamic and kinetic reviews to analyze the behavior of optoelectronic materials at atomic and electronic levels. The content focuses on the material classification, phase transformation, and strengthening mechanisms of LEDs, Laser Diodes, and Photovoltaics. We will specifically explore how composite material systems—including metals, ceramics, polymers, and nanomaterials—influence the conversion efficiency of optoelectronic devices. By analyzing reasons for material failure and prevention methods, students will understand the impact of interface stability on device longevity from a fundamental material perspective. The course also includes Paper Reading sessions to guide students in tracking frontier material research trends.
